decisions.reason: The enclosed manual laser workstation line extends the firm's core laser competence, and with the firm growing and holding slack there is no performance shortfall that would trigger problemistic search, so it is carried forward.
As the flagship laser marking line shown on the home page and central to the firm's Industry 4.0 direction, it is strategically embedded and will be kept regardless of early uncertain results.
The compact laser cabin was newly launched with its own page and complements the laser portfolio, and slack allows the firm to carry it while its results are still uncertain.
The award-winning lubricant printing system opens a niche application in sheet metal processing, and the external recognition supports meeting aspirations, so the firm keeps it.
